notes.subject: ספיח
notes.rationale: safiyaxu — kisɛ min yɛrɛ bɛ wuli, sɛbɛnni bɛ Tanaki kɔnɔ ɲɔgɔn na dɔrɔn de

notes.subject: סחישׁ
notes.rationale: sahixu — daɲɛ nɔgɔman don, min b'a fɔ kisɛ min bɛ wuli o yɛrɛ fɛ

notes.subject: ⟨i ye⟩
notes.rationale: Heburukan tɛ nɔnabila si sɔrɔ; Bamanankan ka kan k'a fɔ tiɲɛnama ye minɛɛ ye

notes.subject: i ye
notes.rationale: tiɲɛnama in bɛ Hizikiya (Ezekiya) ma minɛɛ — daɲɛ in bɛ tugu a kan

notes.subject: san kelen, fila, saba
notes.rationale: san jate-sira: san kelen, filanan, sabanan — waati jatera

translation: Nin ye ⟨i ye⟩ tiɲɛnama ye: nin san in, aw bɛ dun kisɛ min yɛrɛ bɛ wuli o nɔ na (safiyaxu-sira), san filanan na, min bɛ wuli o yɛrɛ fɛ (sahixu), san sabanan na, aw bɛ si bila, aw bɛ furu, aw bɛ winyɛjiriw da, aw bɛ u jiridenw dun.

tokens.gloss: kisɛ min yɛrɛ bɛ wuli o nɔ na
min bɛ wuli o yɛrɛ fɛ
